chapter.heading: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song.
chapter.v:
His foundation
is in the holy mountains.

Jehovah loveth
the gates of ZionMore than all the dwellings of Jacob.

Glorious things
are spoken of thee,O city of God. [Selah

I will
make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me:Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia:This one was born there.

Yea, of
Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her;And the Most High himself will establish her.

Jehovah will
count, when he writeth up the peoples,This one was born there. [Selah

They that
sing as well as they that dance shall say,All my fountains are in thee.
